changelog:
Initial release with complete Omi.me integration for OpenClaw.

- Full support for syncing and managing memories, action items (tasks), and conversations via CLI commands.
- Complete CRUD and sync capabilities for all items.
- Interactive and manual API token management with built-in CLI tools.
- Rate limit handling and troubleshooting guides included.
- Setup scripts and usage examples provided for seamless onboarding.
summary: Complete Omi.me integration for memories, action items (tasks), and conversations. Full CRUD + sync capabilities for OpenClaw.
